description: This file defines a React component named RecommendationsPanel that displays recommended activities like music, podcasts, and breathing exercises. It fetches suggestions based on current mood and traffic data, with fallback static suggestions if data retrieval fails. The component also includes debug information about API endpoints when in debug or info log level.

methods.description: Main React functional component that renders the recommendations UI.
